components.name: Primary Button
components.description: A pill-shaped, tactile action for create and submit flows.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 45px; padding: 0 20px; border: 2px solid var(--animal-bg-color); border-radius: 50px; background: var(--animal-bg-color); color: var(--animal-text-color); font: 600 14px var(--animal-font-family); cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 5px #bdaea0; transition: transform .25s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), box-shadow .25s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 6px #bdaea0; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(2px); box-shadow: 0 1px #bdaea0; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--animal-primary-color); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A quiet secondary action with warm hover feedback.
components.css: .ds-btn-text { min-height: 32px; padding: 0 16px; border: 2px solid transparent; border-radius: 16px; background: transparent; color: var(--animal-text-color); font: 600 12px var(--animal-font-family); cursor: pointer; transition: background .25s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1); } .ds-btn-text:hover { background: var(--animal-bg-color-secondary); } .ds-btn-text:active { background: #e9ddc6; } .ds-btn-text:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--animal-primary-color); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: A light pill field with a warm interior and clear focus state.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; color: var(--animal-text-color); font: 600 12px var(--animal-font-family); } .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 40px; padding: 0 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 50px; background: #fffdf7; color: var(--animal-text-color); font: 500 14px var(--animal-font-family); box-shadow: 0 3px #d4c9b4; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #c4b89e; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--animal-primary-color); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Content Card
components.description: A calm cream surface for mailbox controls and supporting information.
components.html:
Temporary mailbox

Create an address and manage messages here.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 16px 24px; border-radius: 20px; background: #f7f3df; color: #725d42; font: 500 14px/1.5715 var(--animal-font-family); } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--animal-text-color); font-size: 16px; font-weight: 800; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--animal-text-color-secondary); }

components.name: Top Navigation
components.description: A theme-aware header with a compact wordmark, language selector, and theme selector.
components.html: TideMailEnglish · 简体中文 · System / Light / Dark
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; min-height: 68px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; padding: 0 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--animal-border-color-light); background: rgba(248,248,240,.94); font: 700 12px var(--animal-font-family); } .ds-brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: var(--animal-text-color); text-decoration: none; font-size: 16px; } .ds-brand svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; fill: none; stroke: var(--animal-primary-color); stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-nav-link { padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 18px; color: var(--animal-text-color); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { background: var(--animal-bg-color-secondary); }

components.description: A readable, full-width message row with sender, subject, and preview hierarchy.

components.css: .ds-mail-row { display: grid; gap: 6px; padding: 14px 18px; border: 1px solid var(--animal-border-color-light); border-radius: 18px; background: var(--animal-bg-color); color: var(--animal-text-color); font: 500 14px/1.5 var(--animal-font-family); } .ds-mail-row:hover { border-color: var(--animal-primary-color); background: var(--animal-primary-color-bg); } .ds-mail-row strong { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-mail-subject { font-weight: 700; } .ds-mail-preview { display: -webkit-box; overflow: hidden; color: var(--animal-text-color-secondary); font-size: 12px; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; }

narrative.overview:
TideMail pairs a private, temporary mailbox with the calm visual language of Animal-Island-UI. Warm paper surfaces, bark-brown text, rounded controls, and a restrained island-teal accent make the inbox feel approachable while keeping message actions easy to scan.

The interface favors familiar patterns over decoration: create an address, read and manage messages, then open secondary tasks in compact dialogs. The component library supplies the recurring shapes and states; project CSS handles page layout and responsive behavior.
keyCharacteristics: Warm, low-glare paper and cream surfaces.
Brown text with island teal for links, focus, and selected accents.
Rounded controls and compact, readable inbox rows.
System, light, and dark themes with system preference as the default.

rules.name: The Warm Contrast Rule
rules.body: Keep long-form text on warm, light surfaces; use teal as an accent, not as a large text field or page background.

rules.name: The Familiar Type Rule
rules.body: Keep interface text in the bundled Nunito/Noto Sans SC stack; reserve monospace for code examples only.

rules.name: The Tactile Action Rule
rules.body: Reserve visible depth for controls with a direct action; keep content cards flat and calm.

rules.name: The Rounded Control Rule
rules.body: Buttons and inputs stay pill-shaped; cards and message surfaces use generous rounded corners without decorative cutouts.

dos: Do use Animal-Island-UI controls, cards, and the bundled design tokens for recurring UI.
Do keep focus visible and preserve labels for icon-only actions.
Do keep mail HTML inside its sandboxed detail frame.
donts: Don't reintroduce a cold dark page palette, pure-black surfaces, or a second icon set.
Don't add large decorative shadows to cards or non-action content.
Don't remove security checks or mailbox actions as part of a visual cleanup.
